# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Set `.music-table-list* .col-actions` to 6% above 768px and 8% at/below 767px, adjusting other list column widths accordingly.
- Use a fixed 8% width for `.col-actions` in all `music-table-list*` table styles at every breakpoint.
- Keep list action buttons always square (equal width and height) across breakpoints.
